prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters**, especially if you’re looking for a structured program for younger kids. It offers a **Tigers class for ages 4–6** and **kids’ classes for ages 7–12**, with an emphasis on focus, confidence, discipline, and basic self-defense. The school lists small class sizes and a supportive setting.

**ATA Martial Arts – St. Peters**  
6720 Mexico Rd, St. Peters, MO 63376  
(636) 556-5271 · [Program details](https://www.atastpeters.com/our-classes)

If your child is more interested in grappling than kicking and forms, **Onyx Grappling** is another option; it has age-grouped children’s Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes, including for ages 4–6 and 7–9, at **953 Jungermann Road**.

I’d try a class at each and see which instructor and atmosphere your child responds to best. Ask about trial classes, class size, instructor experience with kids, and how they handle safety during partner drills.
